correctness.rationale: For any existing finite thick generalized m-gon (m=3,4,6,8), the endpoint-rooted two-sided distance cells form an equitable weighted cycle because all pre-middle shortest paths are unique (girth 2m) and diameter m excludes other layers. A vertex dipole is constant on cells; its Laplacian solution has direct-edge current R/(1+R) and 2m-1 alternative bundle currents 1/(1+R). Thus every Q column sums to 1+(2m-2)/(1+R), and subtracting the diagonal yields every P column 2m/(1+R); symmetry yields infinity norms. Independent exact grounded-Laplacian computation of all 21 Fano-plane incidence edge columns reproduced Q=53/21,P=16/7. The asserted q=2 versus q>=3 reversal follows from R_m(q,q)=2*sum_{j<m}q^-j+q^-m. Checked the condition that nominal orders need actually exist.
